current_move: Structure-aware full-document extraction with chunked map-reduce/refine and evidence carry-forward
why: Blind first-40k truncation can silently drop the decisive table or footnote; current RAG practice emphasizes retrieval/chunking/evaluation over raw truncation: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.07391

current_move: Field-level provenance: require every extracted value to carry exact source span/page/table coordinates
why: Null-or-stated prompting is good, but span-backed extraction gives deterministic auditability and lets later gates verify the value against text instead of trusting the model.

current_move: Source-of-truth-first reconciliation: deterministic SEC/XBRL facts as primary, LLM only for narrative or ambiguous presentation fields
why: Magnitude gates catch bad reads after the fact; using tagged filings as the canonical numeric layer prevents many unit/scale errors before generation.

current_move: Pre-publish claim-level blocking eval with extracted claims checked against source spans
why: A post-publish nonblocking audit finds defects too late; claim extraction plus source-grounded verification turns the same idea into a release gate.

current_move: Claim-level entailment/fact ledger gate, not only locked-money-unit matching
why: Money-unit gates are strong for numeric drift, but claim-level verification catches wrong directionality, missing qualifiers, period mixups, and unsupported business claims.

current_move: Two-pass draft-then-constrained rewrite / draft-conditioned constrained decoding
why: Hard grammar masks can damage semantics or null outputs; draft-conditioned constrained decoding separates reasoning from syntax enforcement: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03305

current_move: Provider-native strict structured outputs plus typed validation and targeted retry
why: Hand-rolled Ollama JSON grammar is brittle; native strict schema decoding is now the standard baseline for production structured output: https://openai.com/index/introducing-structured-outputs-in-the-api/

current_move: Eval-driven router using per-task quality, cost, latency, and failure-mode scorecards
why: Static fallback is operationally useful, but frontier teams route by measured task performance and known failure modes rather than model preference alone.

current_move: Generation provenance manifest: model version, prompt hash, input hash, schema version, seed, and gate results
why: Locked env inputs help repeatability, but a manifest makes every artifact reproducible and debuggable after models, prompts, or upstream filings change.
